n01-open

A design can look right on the whiteboard and still fail the review board. <break time='200ms'/> Reliability. Security. Cost. Operations. Performance. <break time='150ms'/> You want to find the gaps before the customer does.
n02-title
In this episode: a Well-Architected review of your design, and fixing what it finds in one click.
n03-draft
Here's the clinic booking first draft from episode three. Eight services, about a hundred and nineteen dollars a month. <break time='120ms'/> Would it pass a design review?
n04-validate
Click Validate Architecture. AADB checks the diagram against the Azure Well-Architected Framework, with deterministic rules plus an AI review of the whole design.
n05-score
You get an overall assessment and a score for each of the five pillars, so the weakest areas stand out right away.
n06-scope
And it's clear about its scope: a design-time signal for new Azure designs, not an audit of a deployed environment.
n07-finding
Every finding spells out the issue, the recommendation, and the services it affects. <break time='120ms'/> Click Locate, and those services light up on the canvas.
n08-select
Now pick the high-priority findings you want fixed, and apply them, all in one click.
n09-applying
AADB regenerates the architecture with those recommendations built in.
n10-result
Front Door with a web application firewall now guards the way in, and a secondary region stands by for failover.
n10-result-b
The new services land on the canvas, wired in and grouped, with a note of exactly what was added.
n11-cost
Resilience has a price, and you see it right away. The run rate is updated for the new design.
n12-yours
The AI drew the layout, but it's your diagram, and AADB says so right on the canvas. <break time='100ms'/> Drag groups and services wherever they tell the story best.
n12-yours-b
The AI drew the layout, but it's your diagram. <break time='100ms'/> Drag groups and services wherever they tell the story best.
n13-revalidate
Now revalidate, and see what moved.
n14-compare
Before and after, side by side. <break time='150ms'/> Whatever gaps remain are topics to raise on purpose, not surprises in the review.
n15-report
Download the full report as Markdown to share with the team or bring into the design review.
n16-close
Find the gaps before the review board does. <break time='150ms'/> Then close them in one click.
